date.as_written: samvat 827 mārggaśirakṛṣṇa, catudaśyāntithau, jyeṣṭhānakṣatre, vṛrddhatiyoge, ādityavāsare

notes: The chronogram 'dvīpanetravasuvarṣa' corresponds to 827 (dvīpa = 7, netra = 2, vasu = 8). Kittīpula refers to Kīrtipura (Kirtipur), of which Lakṣmīsiṃha Bhā was the kvāṭhanāyaka (fort commander / governor).
